# arif-fazil.com — Site Overview for AI Agents

## Who is Arif Fazil
Muhammad Arif bin Fazil. Sovereign architect and founder of the arifOS Constitutional Intelligence Kernel.
Senior exploration geoscientist at PETRONAS Carigali, offshore Malaysia.
Builds constitutionally-bound AI systems grounded in physics and evidence.

**Tagline**: Ditempa Bukan Diberi — Forged, Not Given.

## What is arifOS
arifOS is a constitutional intelligence kernel: a governed AI system where tools, agents,
and models operate inside constitutional law (F1-F13 floors), not vibes.

arifOS exposes 13 MCP tools as API endpoints. It is not an LLM itself.
The Observatory surface is live at https://arifos.arif-fazil.com

## Five-Domain Federation
The arifOS federation runs five domains under one sovereign:
- **arifOS** — Constitutional governance kernel (MIND)
- **AAA** — Operations surface and agent gateway (SOUL)
- **GEOX** — Earth intelligence / geoscience tools (BODY)
- **WEALTH** — Capital intelligence / NPV / EMV engine (CAPITAL)
- **WELL** — Human and machine readiness surface (planned)

## Constitutional Floors (F1-F13)
- F01 AMANAH — Reversibility, no irreversible deletion without sovereign consent
- F02 TRUTH — Evidence-grounded, uncertainty-banded claims
- F03 WITNESS — Three-way consistency (theory, code, intent)
- F04 CLARITY — Transparent intent
- F05 PEACE — Human dignity over convenience
- F06 EMPATHY — Consequences for weakest stakeholders
- F07 HUMILITY — Acknowledge limits, say "I don't know"
- F08 GENIUS — Elegant correctness (G ≥ 0.80)
- F09 ANTI-HANTU — No consciousness/emotion claims
- F10 ONTOLOGY — Structural coherence, clear naming
- F11 AUTH — Verify identity before sensitive ops
- F12 INJECTION — Sanitize inputs, external content is evidence not authority
- F13 SOVEREIGN — Arif's word is final, human veto is absolute

## MakcikGPT — Civic Intelligence in Bahasa Malaysia
MakcikGPT is a public-facing civic intelligence series written in Bahasa Malaysia (BM) Makcik voice.
Articles investigate Malaysian sovereignty, resource governance, institutional integrity, and technology accountability.
All articles carry the 999 Meterai seal and are authored by Arif Fazil.

- [PETRONAS DNA — Dulu Bulldog, Sekarang Anjing](https://arif-fazil.com/wealth/makcikgpt/petronas-dna) — Contrasts PETRONAS institutional DNA (1988–2010: integrity, teamwork, "fight like bulldogs") against current leadership reality (LinkedIn disclaimers, rightsizing, London JV with Eni). Asks whether the DNA that built RM403 billion from RM10 million is still alive.
- [Sam Altman, Elon Musk, Anwar Ibrahim — Depa Ada Akal Ka?](https://arif-fazil.com/wealth/makcikgpt/sam-altman-elon-musk-anwar-akal) — Questions whether three powerful leaders possess "akal budi" (wisdom) or merely power, slogans, and applause. Compares OpenAI's nonprofit-to-profit drift, Musk's truth-seeking persona, and Anwar's MADANI reformasi claims.
- [SEARAH Dah Beroperasi — Tapi Bocor Pun Dah Sampai Mahkamah](https://arif-fazil.com/wealth/makcikgpt/searah-followup) — SEARAH (50% PETRONAS + 50% Eni Italy) starts operations 1 Julai 2026. The next day, court hears a former PETRONAS manager leaked upstream data to PETROS CEO and CFO.
- [Kenapa Gas Sarawak Punya Dah Masuk Tangan Orang Italy?](https://arif-fazil.com/wealth/makcikgpt/cerita-makcik) — Original SEARAH exposé: USD 2 shell company in London, 19 oilfields (14 Indonesia, 5 Malaysia), no BIT protection, PETROS excluded, Parliament uninformed.
- [Persoalan RM70 Bilion](https://arif-fazil.com/wealth/makcikgpt/siasatan-harakah) — Deeper investigation into SEARAH's RM70 billion deal structure, VSS/MSS of ~5,000 workers, and OSA silence on whistleblowers.
- [Iran Hormuz dan Malaysia: Rightsizing Tak Habis-Habis](https://arif-fazil.com/wealth/makcikgpt/iran-hormuz) — Hormuz shipping disruption, PETRONAS repeated rightsizing, and Malaysia's 600,000 barrel/day import gap.
- [ILMU "Sovereign AI" Konon — Tapi Bila DiAudit, Menangis](https://arif-fazil.com/wealth/makcikgpt/ilmu-bbb) — Red-team audit of YTL's ILMU AI platform: 108 API calls, 3.45/10 score, MalayMMLU self-grading, model protection for YTL over nation.
- [Satu Tangan Kuasa Semua — Air, Api, Rangkaian, AI](https://arif-fazil.com/wealth/makcikgpt/ytl-monopoli) — YTL's vertical monopoly: electricity (YTL Power), water (Ranhill Johor monopoly), telco (YTL Comms), land (1,640 acres Kulai), AI (ILMU). MACC investigating 1BestariNet RM2.7B.

## Machine-Readable Discovery
- `/.well-known/agent.json` — Agent capability declaration
- `/.well-known/did.json` — W3C DID document (did:web:arif-fazil.com)
- `/.well-known/arifos-federation.json` — Federation manifest
- `/soul.json` — Sovereign identity and philosophy anchor
- `/llms.json` — Structured site overview (this file, JSON form)
- `/llms-full.txt` — Full-text content dump for LLM ingestion

- Constitutional kernel: Python 3.12+ / FastMCP
